metadata.XMP-dc:Creator: STRINGER
metadata.XMP-dc:Description:
TO GO WITH AFP STORY by Fran Blandy : Africa's biggest ski resort taking shape in tiny Lesotho
People ski 21 June 2007 on a piste of the Afri-Ski resort in the Mahlasela Valley, Lesotho. The glare of the afternoon sun and snow guns lining the piste indicate it won't be downhill all the way, but the tiny kingdom Lesotho is the unlikely venue of ambitious plans to create the number one destination for skiers in Africa. 'This is going to be the biggest ski resort in Africa,' says Ollie Esplin as he tries to explain the problems in minimising the risks of meltdown at the Afri-Ski resort in Lesotho's picturesque Mahlasela Valley. Militants stormed into the compound detonating a car bomb and firing shots on late 08 July, in an attempt to take control of the buildings inside. metadata.IPTC:Caption-Abstract: CEUTA, SPAIN - JULY 30: Hundreds of migrants have attempted to swim from Morocco to the Spanish city of Ceuta in North Africa, while the number of arrivals exceeded 1,500 in just over a week, according to local news in Cueta, Spain on July 30, 2026. As Moroccan and Algerian migrants attempted to reach Ceuta by swimming, most were reportedly intercepted by Moroccan patrol boats. Spain's Maritime Rescue Service and the Spanish Red Cross rescued 117 people from the water, while the Civil Guard assisted around 200 others with patrol boats. The Spanish Civil Guard also found two bodies which raised the death toll along Ceuta's coastline so far this year to 29. Marcos Moreno / Anadolu (Photo by MARCOS MORENO / Anadolu via AFP)

EFE/ Sara Cavallini/AC MILAN/SÓLO USO EDITORIAL/SÓLO DISPONIBLE PARA ILUSTRAR LA NOTICIA QUE ACOMPAÑA (CRÉDITO OBLIGATORIO)

kun-uz.title: Ikki tumanda obodonlashtirish boshqarmasi mas’ullari ming tonnadan ortiq asfaltni talon-toroj qildi.
Italiya “migrantlar bosqini” sababli Ispaniya bilan chegaralarini yopdi.
Tinchlik kengashi va Tramp Hamasni qurolsizlantirish bo‘yicha kelishuvni e’lon qildi. Nimalar ma’lum?.
Latviyaga ishlagani boradigan o‘zbekistonlik haydovchilar uchun yangi tizim tashkil etilishi mumkin.
Bog‘chalarda ishlayotgan o‘rta maxsus ma’lumotli pedagoglar uchun dual ta’lim tartibi joriy etilishi mumkin.
Infantinoga qarshi urush. Bu haqda nimalar ma’lum?.
Apple va Google O‘zbekistonda yarim yilda 33 mlrd so‘mdan soliq to‘ladi.
Andijonda davlat zaxirasidagi yerni sotmoqchi bo‘lganlar ushlandi.
1 so‘mlik soliq, yashirin dori ombori va 80 ming chiptasiz yo‘lovchi - mahalliy dayjyest.
Prezident temir yo‘l transporti sohasi xodimlarini kasb bayrami bilan tabrikladi.
O‘zbekiston va Qirg‘iziston o‘rtasida pensiya ta’minoti to‘g‘risidagi bitim imzolandi.
Shavkat Mirziyoyev Issiqko‘ldagi besh yulduzli “Boku” mehmonxonasi ochilish marosimida ishtirok etdi.
Iyunda 2,5 mlrd kub gaz qazib olindi. Bu o‘tgan yilning mos davridan 25 foizga kam.

metadata.IPTC:Caption-Abstract: CEUTA, 31/07/2026.- Un número de inmigrantes regresan a pie a su país de origen (Marruecos), este viernes. El número de cadáveres encontrados en las últimas horas en la costa de la ciudad española de Ceuta tras la entrada masiva de personas procedentes de Marruecos asciende ya a 43, informaron a EFE fuentes policiales. Las fuerzas de seguridad y los servicios de emergencia siguen localizando algunos cuerpos de las miles de personas, sobre todo marroquíes y argelinos, que se lanzaron al mar desde las costas marroquíes de Castillejos para intentar alcanzar la costa ceutí a nado en los últimos días; y no se descarta que la cifra continúe aumentando. EFE/ Reduan Dris
